heading: This Afternoon
text: A mix of sun and clouds. Chance of a few widely scattered showers or an isolated thunderstorm. Warm and humid. Highs in the 80s to near 90. Light south wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Rain showers and spotty thunderstorms developing overnight. Some patches of valley fog. Mild and muggy. Lows in the 60s to near 70. Calm wind.

heading: Saturday
text: Morning clouds, with a few localized showers and thunderstorms, then additional scattered showers and storms developing in the afternoon. Warm and humid. Highs ranging through the 80s. Light southwest wind.
